description: Pins protocol::encode_embeddings_blob_raw + protocol::decode_embeddings_blob byte mapping for the MYR1 vault.embeddings encrypted on-device AI-embedding-index codec (MYND-453). The inner plaintext is OPAQUE (client-serialized embedding store: semantic-search / Q&A dense vectors + {note_id -> content_nonce} manifest + model-identity tuple) — no canonical-JSON discipline, unlike vault-prefs; the structural twin of vault.search / vault.indices. The inner postcard snapshot is engine-opaque and is NOT pinned here — only the envelope + AAD framing. ai_embeddings_key = derive_subkey(root_key, SubkeyRole::AiEmbeddingsKey) (role 'ai-embeddings-key'); account_number_hash binds via aad_ai_embeddings_blob (role 'ai-embeddings-blob' — a DISTINCT load-bearing string, and DISTINCT from search-index-key/-blob and vault-indices-key/-blob: one magic + one KEK per blob family, MYR1 != MYS1 != MYI1). Model-swap invalidation rides inside the opaque payload (the §9.17.2 model-identity tuple), NOT the AAD. 12 cases: 3 encrypt (empty / small descriptor / 1-KB) + 1 decrypt_ok + 2 decrypt_aead_fail (tag-tamper + cross-vault, both non-distinguishing per §6.4, real-key fixtures) + 6 parse_fail (one per distinguishable pre-decryption structural reject incl. the load-bearing format_unsupported forward hook). Cases generated by `cargo test -p protocol --lib emit_embeddings_vectors_for_paste -- --ignored` (in protocol/src/embeddings_blob.rs).

cases.description: Encode an empty inner plaintext (no embedding index persisted — the caller-side fall-to-rebuild / re-embed default). The smallest valid MYR1 blob: 34-byte header + 0-byte ciphertext + 32-byte CTX tag = 66 bytes. ciphertext_len field = 32.

Encode a 36-byte opaque descriptor standing in for a tiny vector-store snapshot (a couple of vectors + manifest + model-identity tuple). The codec is byte-transparent — the inner serialization is the desktop engine's, not the codec's, and is NOT pinned here. Expected blob = 34 + 36 + 32 = 102 bytes.
Encode a 1024-byte plaintext where byte i = (i mod 256). Mid-size case — exercises a full XChaCha20 keystream block plus tail. Expected blob = 34 + 1024 + 32 = 1090 bytes.

Round-trip the small-descriptor blob back to its opaque plaintext under the matching root_key (-> ai_embeddings_key) + account_number_hash. Proves the decoder's header parse + AEAD unwrap reconstruct the exact inner bytes the desktop layer will deserialize.

Take the small-descriptor blob and flip the final byte (inside the 32-byte CTX commitment tag) via XOR 0xFF. The decoder MUST surface a non-distinguishing CannotDecrypt — the recomputed CTX commitment no longer matches. Same observable outcome as the cross-vault case below (spec §6.4).
cases.informational_tamper_description: final byte (inside CTX tag) flipped via XOR 0xFF

cases.description: Take the intact small-descriptor blob but decrypt under a DIFFERENT account_number_hash (0x44x16 instead of 0x33x16). aad_ai_embeddings_blob binds the account hash, so the AAD differs and AEAD verification fails — a blob from vault A cannot be opened against vault B. Collapses to the same CannotDecrypt as the tamper case; ports MUST NOT distinguish the two.
cases.informational_tamper_description: intact blob decrypted under wrong account_number_hash (0x44x16)

cases.description: First byte of the MYR1 magic corrupted to 'X'. Rejected at offset 0 before any decryption (magic-byte-before-decrypt discipline, §9.17.1).
protocol_version byte (offset 4) set to 0x02 instead of 0x01. A v0.1 decoder rejects an unknown protocol version before decrypting.

embeddings_format_version byte (offset 5) set to 0x02 — a future embedding-store serialization a v0.1 client does not understand. The decoder rejects cleanly so the caller falls to rebuild (re-embed) from the .myn files (§9.17.4). This is the forward-migration hook and is load-bearing. NOTE: model-identity drift (a model / dimension / chunker change) is handled INSIDE the opaque payload, not by bumping this byte.
Only the 4-byte MYR1 magic, no room for the 34-byte header. Rejected before any field read.
Valid header advertising ciphertext_len = N, but the blob is one byte shorter than header + N. Rejected before the AEAD stage.

ciphertext_len field (offset 30..34) set to 0xFFFFFFFF, far above MAX_EMBEDDINGS_PLAINTEXT_LEN + 32 (256 MiB + 32). The overflow guard rejects before any slice indexing — a port MUST bound-check ciphertext_len before allocating or indexing.
